Snapshot: 2026-11-02. MIT license: LICENSE, unchanged.
Vendored CMake, include/, src/, docs/, data/ and the required Code/CodeEditor
dependencies (Lexilla, Scintilla headers, SciTE profiles and TextEditor).
No bundled ImGui, audio/browser runtime, Python binding or demo is used.
Sources are unchanged; the application selects explicit CyUI module targets
and supplies its existing Dear ImGui target. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
